summary: Client only. A movie clip in your NativeScreen. You can create child clips and text fields, draw shapes, attach symbols from the game's movies, load pictures and listen for the mouse. The game's fonts are DefaultFont, DefaultFontItalic, DefaultFontBold, LightFont, LightFontItalic, LightFontBold, Manuscript and DisplayFont.

key.summary: Its path of names below the root.

valid.summary: False once the clip or its screen is gone.
valid.exampleLua:
if panel.valid then
  panel:set({ alpha = 0.5 })
end

attach.summary: Adds a symbol the screen's movie exports as a new child clip, or returns null. See NativeUI.libraries.
attach.example:
const symbol = kcds.ui.NativeUI.libraries()?.[0]?.exports[0];
const button = symbol ? screen.root.attach(symbol) : null;
attach.exampleLua:
local symbol = (kcds.ui.NativeUI.libraries()[1] and kcds.ui.NativeUI.libraries()[1].exports)[1]
local button = (symbol and screen.root:attach(symbol) or nil)

createClip.summary: An empty child clip, or null.
createClip.example:
const panel = screen.root.createClip();
panel.set({ x: 100, y: 80 });
createClip.exampleLua:
local panel = screen.root:createClip()
panel:set({ x = 100, y = 80 })
createClip.exampleCs:
var panel = screen.Root.CreateClip();
panel.Set(new { x = 100, y = 80 });

createText.summary: A child text field in the game's fonts, or null. It wraps and cannot be selected.
createText.example:
const label = screen.root.createText({ x: 20, y: 20, width: 300, height: 30, text: 'Hello' });
label.setTextStyle({ font: 'DefaultFontBold', size: 18, color: 0xe8dcc0 });
createText.exampleLua:
local label = screen.root:createText({ x = 20, y = 20, width = 300, height = 30, text = "Hello" })
label:setTextStyle({ font = "DefaultFontBold", size = 18, color = 0xe8dcc0 })
createText.exampleCs:
var label = screen.Root.CreateText(new { x = 20, y = 20, width = 300, height = 30, text = "Hello" });
label.SetTextStyle(new { font = "DefaultFontBold", size = 18, color = 0xe8dcc0 });

set.summary: Changes display fields: `x`, `y`, `rotation`, `scaleX` and `scaleY`, where 1 is normal, `alpha`, 0 to 1, and `visible`.
set.example: panel.set({ x: 100, y: 80, scaleX: 1.5, scaleY: 1.5, alpha: 0.9, visible: true });
set.exampleLua: panel:set({ x = 100, y = 80, scaleX = 1.5, scaleY = 1.5, alpha = 0.9, visible = true })
set.exampleCs: panel.Set(new { x = 100, y = 80, scaleX = 1.5, scaleY = 1.5, alpha = 0.9, visible = true });

get.summary: Reads an ActionScript member of the clip.

setMember.summary: Sets an ActionScript member of the clip.

setTextStyle.summary: Styles a text field with `font`, `size`, `color`, `align` and `bold`.
setTextStyle.example: title.setTextStyle({ font: 'DisplayFont', size: 24, color: 0xd9c9a3, align: 'center', bold: true });
setTextStyle.exampleLua: title:setTextStyle({ font = "DisplayFont", size = 24, color = 0xd9c9a3, align = "center", bold = true })
setTextStyle.exampleCs: title.SetTextStyle(new { font = "DisplayFont", size = 24, color = 0xd9c9a3, align = "center", bold = true });

params.html: Optional: true for the HTML text.

goto.summary: Moves the clip's timeline to a frame or label.

invoke.summary: Calls an ActionScript method of the clip.

params.args: Its arguments, in one array or separately; none when left out.

draw.summary: Draws vector shapes in one frame, from a list of [method, ...args] using clear, lineStyle, beginFill, endFill, moveTo, lineTo or curveTo.
draw.exampleCs: panel.Draw(new object[] { new[] { "clear" }, new object[] { "lineStyle", 2, 0xd9c9a3, 100 }, new object[] { "beginFill", 0x15130f, 80 }, new object[] { "moveTo", 0, 0 }, new object[] { "lineTo", 400, 0 }, new object[] { "lineTo", 400, 200 }, new object[] { "lineTo", 0, 200 }, new[] { "endFill" } });

members.summary: The names of this clip's child clips, text fields and variables.

on.summary: Listens for the mouse on this clip: 'press', 'release', 'releaseOutside', 'rollOver', 'rollOut', 'dragOver' or 'dragOut'.
on.exampleLua:
closeLabel:on("press", function() return screen:close() end)
closeLabel:on("rollOver", function() return closeLabel:set({ alpha = 1 }) end)
closeLabel:on("rollOut", function() return closeLabel:set({ alpha = 0.7 }) end)

off.summary: Removes your handlers of an event.

setMask.summary: Masks the clip with another clip, or removes the mask with null.

setHitArea.summary: Makes another clip the area receiving this clip's mouse events, or removes it with null.

setLeading.summary: Sets a text field's leading: the pixels added between its lines, from -64 to 256 (negative pulls them together), so its lines can match rows drawn behind them. Returns false when the screen has closed. Throws a TypeError for other values.

params.pixels: The extra space between lines, in whole pixels.

setLeading.exampleLua:
local list = panel:createText({ x = 40, y = 40, width = 300, height = 280 })
list:setLeading(6)
list:setText("First\nSecond\nThird")

setTabStops.summary: Sets a text field's tab stops, in pixels from its left: a tab character in its text moves on to the next stop, so one field can show columns. Up to 15 whole numbers from 0 to 8192. Returns false when the screen has closed. Throws a TypeError for other stops.
setTabStops.exampleLua:
local table = panel:createText({ x = 40, y = 40, width = 600, height = 200 })
table:setTabStops({ 0, 220, 400 })
table:setText("Name	Count	Price")

load.summary: Loads a picture or movie into the clip: img:// or imgps:// for the engine's image loader, or a movie path in the game's archives.

loadShipped.summary: Loads a file your resource ships into the clip.

params.path: The file's path in your resource.

remove.summary: Removes the clip and its children.
